# r2dbc-coroutines-service

> Coroutine data-access layer with a bounded suspending connection pool, cancellation-safe transactions, per-call timeouts and a guard that fails blocking calls on event-loop threads Kotlin library `io.github.trysac:r2dbc-coroutines-service`, package
> `io.github.trysac.r2dbc_coroutines_service`, MIT licensed, Kotlin 2 on Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
